name: Haven: Mages of Magic
source:
Being accepted into Haven, you will meet fellow classmates, study hard, and unearth the secrets terrorizing the students on campus.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你被庇護所錄取了。在這裡，你將結識同學、埋頭苦讀，並揭開那些讓校園裡的學生們惶恐不安的秘密。

［取自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
